history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V32 workload, representation, width, quick/full/publication job count, checksum, execution mode, scored operation, timing boundary, occupancy rule, native runner, mixed-tier replay signature, and publication ruling. It changes no production engine behavior or scored timing row. It restores the native Shape transition counter map to the versioned attribution inventory, validates it fail-closed, preserves it through phase deltas and checkpoints, and renders it for shared-realm rows. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, or attribution inventory change creates another version.
change: Adds the already-emitted native Shape transition map to the accepted attribution contract. Every configuration/warmup/invocation snapshot now retains exact requests, hits, misses, and writer-lock scheduler yields; missing, extra, non-integral, regressing, or incoherent maps reject collection. Scored timing, workload identities, checksums, and all other attribution domains are unchanged.

tier_attribution.shape_invariant: Every cumulative snapshot and phase delta is integral and nonnegative; requests = hits + misses. Writer-lock yields are exact scheduler-yield events and may exceed misses because one publication attempt can yield more than once.
tier_attribution.equivalence: V33 preserves V32 tier/environment equivalence. For warmup and invocation independently at each supported mode/lane count, every base/variant pair must select the same non-empty execution-tier set and allocate exactly the same number of environments. Every shared invocation records exactly one worker run per lane. Exact Shape requests/hits/misses/writer yields and every inherited tier, timing, runtime, synchronization, allocation, GC-pause, process CPU, resident-memory, and worker value remain visible rather than normalized away; every Wasm workload records an invocation-phase Wasm dispatch.
